# DevFlow Technology — Full Manifest

> DevFlow Technology is an international AI Systems, Custom Software Infrastructure & Enterprise Software Engineering Company based in Ahmedabad, Gujarat, India.

DevFlow Technology delivers high-performance AI software systems, autonomous AI agents, RAG search pipelines, enterprise ERP platforms, custom SaaS web applications, cloud infrastructure, and Generative Engine Optimization (GEO/AEO).

**Entity Information:**
- **Legal Name**: DevFlow Technology
- **Website**: https://www.devflow.co.in
- **Email**: info@devflow.co.in
- **Location**: Ahmedabad, Gujarat, India - 382210
- **Founders**: Prince Gajjar (Founder & CEO), Bhavin Rajput (Co-Founder & CTO)

---

## 1. Core Engineering Pillars
- **Architecture-First Development**: Database schemas, security roles, and API contracts designed prior to frontend execution.
- **Direct Founder Access**: Founders Prince Gajjar & Bhavin Rajput lead technical architecture and milestone reviews.
- **100% IP Source Code Ownership**: Full source code transfer upon project completion with zero monthly seat licensing or vendor lock-in.
- **Security-Conscious Engineering**: OWASP Top 10 guidelines, TLS 1.3 encryption in transit, AES-256 at rest, and strict environment isolation.
- **Radical Transparency**: Weekly active sprint demos, staging build access, and clear progress reporting.
- **180-Day Warranty & Support**: Post-launch maintenance SLAs and bug resolution guarantees.

---

## 3. Technology Stack Specifications
- **Frontend**: Next.js 16 (App Router), React 19, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, Framer Motion
- **Backend**: Node.js, Express, Python, FastAPI, Go
- **Databases & Cache**: PostgreSQL, Redis, MongoDB, Cloudflare D1
- **Cloud & DevOps**: AWS (Amazon Web Services), Docker, Vercel, Cloudflare
- **AI & RAG Engines**: OpenAI API, Gemini API, LangChain, Pinecone, Qdrant, PgVector
